_about: Hand-written part of compat.json. scripts/write-compat.mjs adds the kit version, the exact framework versions that the compatibility tests installed, and whether each test run passed. Edit this file when notes or the styling-library results change. Do not write framework version numbers here.

frameworks.name: Angular
frameworks.note: Angular CLI build, strict templates, zoneless. Use defineCustomElements() from the loader; $event.detail is typed

frameworks.name: React
frameworks.note: Vite production build. Register each component from @evoke-tech/stencil-ui-kit/components/<name>.js (the loader does not work in Vite builds). Events: onevokeChange

frameworks.name: React
frameworks.note: Same registration as React 19. Object props and events need a ref (set the property, use addEventListener), see the README

frameworks.name: Vue
frameworks.note: Vite production build. The /vue wrappers need no setup. Raw tags need isCustomElement, per-component registration and addEventListener for events
